practicalCriteria: Each rated standard can be traced to the written role description or a written procedure
Each rating shows its evidence, date and source, and its comment links the rating to the evidence
The staff member's comments are recorded, or a statement that they declined to comment is recorded
Each improvement action has a support item, a measure and a due date
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: evidence list with dates and sources
